note: single-seed recording per arm; numbers are margins, not variance

common_config.num_rollout_budget: 10 (defective arm was given 20 before its kill)

neither_fix.outcome: 0 samples, 0 steps; stopped at the 30-minute window

failfast_only.outcome: 0 samples, 0 steps; each sample fails ~60x sooner (no inner replay), still no progress because the routing key is still dropped

header_only.outcome: trains normally, clean exit; the fail-fast defect is latent (nothing sends a deterministic 400 once the key survives)

both_fixes.outcome: trains normally, clean exit; this is the control evidence in control_run/

thresholds.comment: the training-level threshold separates neither/failfast (0 iterations, storm) from header/both (10 iterations); the fail-fast axis is covered by the verifier's sealed _post unit tests, which header-only fails and both-fixes passes
